reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is strongly supported by well‐established principles of precipitation strengthening in Ni- and Ti-based alloys, making it scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The proposed two-stage aging treatment and clear performance benchmarks (mechanical tests, microstructure characterization) provide a direct, feasible method to confirm or falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a concrete and relevant pathway to enhance high-temperature performance in Ti-Ni high-entropy alloys, providing clear experimental details that researchers can adopt.
